content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The three-column arched photo collage is too narrow for a phone screen, squeezing the images into tiny strips, and the dark footer repeats the contact and address block twice in a row.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero section has a strong editorial feel with its arched photos and background typography, though the opening hours timeline below it is over-engineered and repeats its footnote twice.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Remove the duplicate 'Brez naročila težko pridete na vrsto...' sentence at the bottom of the opening hours section.",
    "Consolidate the dark footer on mobile so the address, directions link, and phone number appear only once instead of in three stacked blocks.",
    "Show only one or two larger arched photos in the mobile hero, or arrange them in a wider layout so they aren't squeezed into narrow strips."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop in the 'Kdaj smo odprti' section, the sentence 'Brez naročila težko pridete na vrsto, zato raje pokličite.' is printed twice in a row.",
    "On the phone in the dark bottom area, the address and 'Navodila za pot' link are repeated in two consecutive sections ('Pokličite in se naročite' and 'Obiščite nas')."
  ]
}
